events.title: The Offering Hour Demo v0.6.0: rebuilt for Steam Next Fest

events.title: Demo v0.5.2 — Heavier hits, smarter packs, defeat screen.
events.summary: The Offering Hour Demo v0.5.2 is now live.This update is about how combat feels, and about making a lost run tell you something.Combat feel- Avatar heavy skills now land with a brief hit-stop, and an Avatar's descent hits harder when it arrives.- Heroes and monsters now react to being hit: light blows nudge them, heavy blows knock them back.- Monster packs now surround their target instead of piling into one jittering clump.- Avatar roars no longer get cut off in the middle of a big fight.How sk

events.title: Demo v0.5.0 — Three-Way Arena Brawls: Reinforcement Waves & a Third Faction
events.summary: Sacrificers, the arena is no longer a 1v1.- Heroes don't fight alone anymore: human, dwarf, elf and Silverguard reinforcements pour in through portals, wave after wave- A second hero steps through the main gate to join the hunt when the fight turns against them- Slay a hero and the Silverguard retaliates, led by a Silverguard Captain; push the last hero to the brink and their entire army marches in- A third faction crashes the party: bandit gangs and viking raiders barge into the arena at random

events.title: Demo v0.4.0: Speed Overhaul + 30 Combat Fixes
events.summary: Until now, every monster you summoned moved at roughly the same speed, and none of them could ever catch a hero.This update rebuilds the entire speed system. Whether you can run a hero down is now a deckbuilding decision.⚡ Speed System Overhaul▸ All 84 monsters re-tiered into nine speed tiers, from super-heavy tanks to suicide bombers▸ Want to finish off a fleeing hero?
